items.title: Characteristics of Outpatient Care Settings Associated with Implementation Outcomes for a Group Physical Therapy Program.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of a cluster randomized hybrid implementation trial identified organizational and contextual characteristics associated with the successful adoption and implementation of group physical therapy for knee osteoarthritis in 19 VHA outpatient PT departments.
items.curatedReason: 在 VHA 体系内推行膝骨关节炎小组物理治疗，成功与否取决于特定的组织和背景因素，本研究对此提供了深入观察。对于希望推广类似小组治疗模式的科室，应重点关注这19个 VHA 门诊 PT 部门在人员配备、领导支持和流程优化方面的经验。
items.titleZh: 门诊护理环境中与小组物理治疗项目实施结果相关的特征
items.summaryZh: 一项针对集群随机混合 III 型实施试验的二次分析，在 19 个 VHA 门诊物理治疗部门中，评估了组织和背景特征与膝骨关节炎小组物理治疗项目实施（如采纳率）之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: Successful implementation of group physical therapy for knee osteoarthritis within the VHA hinges on specific organizational and contextual factors, as this study observes. For departments looking to adopt similar group models, prioritize insights from these 19 VHA outpatient PT departments regarding staffing, leadership support, and process optimization.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于 VHA 门诊物理治疗部门，其结果外推到其他医疗系统或私立诊所时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study was confined to VHA outpatient physical therapy departments, limiting generalizability to other healthcare systems or private practices.

items.title: Operational AI Adoption in U.S. Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities: Organizational Selection and Domain Heterogeneity, 2021-2024
items.summary: U.S. Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRFs) are increasingly adopting operational AI solutions between 2021 and 2024, driven by workforce shortages and the complex Medicare prospective payment system, with varied adoption across clinical domains.
items.curatedReason: 这份报告显示美国住院康复机构（IRF）正在加速采用 AI，特别是在劳动力短缺和 Medicare 复杂报销压力下。它提示你，AI 在IRF 的应用正从早期尝试转向运营实践，你所在机构的未来运营模式可能会因此改变。
items.titleZh: 美国住院康复机构的运营级 AI 采用：组织选择与领域异质性，2021-2024
items.summaryZh: 受劳动力短缺和复杂 Medicare 预付款制度驱动，美国住院康复机构（IRFs）在2021至2024年间加速采用运营级 AI 解决方案，不同临床领域的采用情况存在异质性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This report shows that U.S. Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRFs) are accelerating AI adoption, particularly under workforce shortages and complex Medicare reimbursement pressures. It suggests that AI applications in IRFs are shifting from early trials to operational practice, potentially altering future operating models for your facility.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Person-centred working relationships that focus on the unique goals of the individual are the heart of supported self-management: a qualitative study with stroke survivors.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 stroke survivors in England found that person-centered working relationships are at the heart of supported self-management during community stroke rehabilitation, focusing on individual goals and the "long and winding journey of self-management."
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调，卒中康复中支持性自我管理的核心是个性化工作关系。它提醒你，在与卒中幸存者建立康复联盟时，要专注于他们的独特目标，并将其作为长期自我管理的关键。
items.titleZh: 以个体为中心的工作关系是卒中幸存者支持性自我管理的核心：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对英国21名卒中幸存者的定性研究发现，以个体为中心的工作关系是社区卒中康复中支持性自我管理的核心，强调聚焦个体独特目标是长期自我管理的关键。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights that person-centered working relationships are crucial for supported self-management in stroke rehabilitation. It reminds you to focus on unique individual goals when building therapeutic alliances with stroke survivors, framing it as key to long-term self-management.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（21名卒中幸存者），结果的普遍性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (21 stroke survivors), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Reframing patient expectations as therapeutic targets in musculoskeletal care.
items.summary: This professional practice article argues that patient expectations (PEs) are not merely prognostic indicators but modifiable, multidimensional therapeutic targets that extend beyond treatment and recovery to influence outcomes in musculoskeletal care.
items.curatedReason: 这篇专业实践文章提醒你，患者期望不只是预后因素，更是可主动干预的治疗靶点。在骨科 / 肌肉骨骼康复中，你需要更重视其对治疗效果的影响。
items.titleZh: 重构患者期望为肌肉骨骼康复中的治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 这篇专业实践文章指出，患者期望（PEs）不仅是预后指标，更是可被调整、多维度的治疗靶点，其影响超越治疗和康复本身，在肌肉骨骼护理中能塑性治疗效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This professional practice article reminds you that patient expectations are not just prognostic factors but modifiable therapeutic targets. In orthopedic/musculoskeletal rehabilitation, you need to pay more attention to their impact on treatment outcomes.

items.title: Towards global standards in stroke rehabilitation and recovery: An international evaluation of practice alignment.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study evaluated how Centres of Clinical Excellence criteria align with routine clinical practice in 15 international stroke rehabilitation centers from 10 countries, exploring contextual factors influencing practices across diverse health systems.
items.curatedReason: 这项国际性混合方法研究揭示了全球卒中康复中心在实践中与卓越临床标准的一致性，为你了解不同卫生系统下的实践差异提供了参考。
items.titleZh: 迈向全球卒中康复和恢复标准：一项实践一致性的国际评估
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法研究评估了来自 10 个国家 15 个国际卒中康复中心在日常临床实践中与卓越临床标准的一致性，并探讨了影响不同卫生系统实践的背景因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This international mixed-methods study reveals the alignment of stroke rehabilitation centers with clinical excellence criteria, offering insights into practice variations across diverse health systems.
items.limitation: 研究设计为混合方法，可能存在选择偏倚，且无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The mixed-methods study design may introduce selection bias and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Carrying an unseen weight: the neuro-perceptual landscape of limb heaviness after stroke- a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified perceived limb heaviness as an under-recognized stroke symptom, often unrelated to weakness or spasticity. Proposed mechanisms include altered sensorimotor integration, impaired proprioception, and disrupted body representation, suggesting issues in sensorimotor processing.
items.curatedReason: 中风后肢体沉重感常常被忽视，但它可能提示感觉运动整合异常或本体感觉受损。本综述是梳理这一现象的首批尝试之一，为理解其机制和制定康复策略提供了基础。
items.titleZh: 中风后肢体沉重感的神经感知图景：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述指出，中风后感知到的肢体沉重感是一个未被充分认识的症状，可能与感觉运动整合异常、本体感觉受损和身体表征障碍等机制有关，而非单纯的无力或痉挛。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-stroke limb heaviness is an often-overlooked symptom, potentially indicating altered sensorimotor integration or impaired proprioception. This review is among the first to map this phenomenon, providing a foundation for understanding its mechanisms and developing rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，未能提供干预措施的疗效证据。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, this study does not provide evidence on the efficacy of interventions.

items.title: Application of non-invasive electroencephalogram-based brain-computer interfaces in post-stroke hand function rehabilitation.
items.summary: This article reviews the application of non-invasive EEG-based brain-computer interfaces (BCI) for post-stroke hand function rehabilitation. BCI decodes imagined hand movements to drive exoskeletons, FES, or VR devices, aiming to remodel neural pathways and promote motor recovery.
items.curatedReason: 对于传统康复手段效果不佳的中风手功能障碍患者，基于非侵入性脑电图的脑机接口（BCI）有望通过实时解码运动意图并驱动外部设备，促进神经通路重塑和运动恢复。
items.titleZh: 非侵入性脑电图脑机接口在中风后手功能康复中的应用
items.summaryZh: 本文综述了非侵入性脑电图脑机接口（BCI）在中风后手功能康复中的应用。该技术通过解码患者想象的手部运动信号，驱动外骨骼、功能性电刺激或虚拟现实设备，以促进受损神经通路的重塑和运动恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients with hand dysfunction who do not respond to conventional rehabilitation, non-invasive EEG-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offer a promising avenue. By decoding real-time movement intentions and driving external devices, BCIs can promote neural pathway remodeling and motor recovery.
items.limitation: 本综述主要关注技术原理和应用潜力，未提供具体临床试验结果或疗效数据。
items.limitationEn: This review primarily focuses on technical principles and potential applications, without providing specific clinical trial results or efficacy data.

items.title: Strengthening Cardiac Rehabilitation: Key Strategies for Enhancing Accessibility and Outcomes
items.summary: A qualitative study interviewed 10 leaders from high-performing cardiac rehabilitation programs to identify strategies associated with improved patient participation and adherence. Findings reveal practical approaches to enhance accessibility and outcomes in CR.
items.curatedReason: 提高心脏康复的可及性和依从性对改善患者预后至关重要。本研究通过访谈高绩效心脏康复项目的负责人，总结了成功策略，可为你的项目改进提供实践参考。
items.titleZh: 加强心脏康复：提高可及性和成果的关键策略
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究通过访谈10位高绩效心脏康复项目负责人，旨在识别与提高患者参与度和依从性相关的关键策略。研究结果揭示了改善心脏康复可及性和成果的实用方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Improving accessibility and adherence to cardiac rehabilitation is crucial for better patient outcomes. This study, by interviewing leaders of high-performing cardiac rehab programs, summarizes successful strategies that can provide practical references for your program's improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性访谈，样本量小且基于领导者主观视角，可能存在选择偏倚和推广性局限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative interview study with a small sample size based on leaders' subjective perspectives, which may have selection bias and limited generalizability.

items.title: White Matter Diffusion Anisotropy and the Effects of Inpatient Multidisciplinary Rehabilitation in Parkinson's Disease: A Diffusion Tensor Imaging Analysis.
items.summary: A diffusion tensor imaging analysis found that pretreatment corticospinal tract fractional anisotropy predicted responsiveness to an 8-week inpatient multidisciplinary rehabilitation program in 94 Parkinson's disease patients, with responders showing significant UPDRS Part III improvement.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，帕金森病患者接受多学科康复前，特定白质束的完整性可能预示其对康复的响应程度。这为你未来评估患者的康复潜力提供了新的生物标志物方向，并可能有助于更精准地制定个体化康复方案。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者白质弥散各向异性与多学科住院康复效果：一项弥散张量成像分析
items.summaryZh: 一项弥散张量成像分析发现，94名帕金森病患者在8周多学科住院康复前，皮质脊髓束的分数各向异性可预测康复响应性，其中响应者在UPDRS Part III量表上显示出显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that pretreatment white matter integrity in specific tracts may predict rehabilitation response in Parkinson's disease patients receiving multidisciplinary inpatient rehabilitation. This offers a new biomarker direction for assessing patient rehabilitation potential and could help in tailoring individualized rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且主要关注白质弥散各项异性指标，可能未充分考虑其他影响康复反应的因素。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size and primarily focuses on white matter diffusion anisotropy, potentially not fully accounting for other factors influencing rehabilitation response.

items.title: Impact of Social Determinants of Health on Physical Therapy Utilization in Home Health and Outpatient Settings: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study found that patient-, hospital-, and regional-level social determinants of health (SDOH) were associated with the utilization of home health and outpatient physical therapy after lower extremity joint replacement (LEJR) in Medicare beneficiaries aged 66 and older.
items.curatedReason: 本观察性研究揭示了社会经济地位、居住地和医院特征等社会因素与患者在全髋/膝关节置换术后接受康复治疗的比例显著相关。这提醒你，在评估和规划患者康复路径时，要将这些非临床因素纳入考量，以优化服务利用率。
items.titleZh: 社会健康决定因素对居家和门诊物理治疗利用率的影响：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究发现，在66岁及以上接受下肢关节置换术的Medicare受益人中，患者、医院和区域层面的社会健康决定因素与居家和门诊物理治疗的利用率相关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study reveals that socioeconomic status, residence, and hospital characteristics are significantly associated with PT utilization after total hip/knee replacement. This highlights the importance of considering these non-clinical factors when evaluating and planning patient rehabilitation pathways to optimize service access.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性横断面观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且数据来源于Medicare，可能不完全代表所有患者群体。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cross-sectional observational study cannot establish causality and uses Medicare data, which may not represent all patient populations.

items.title: Improvement in functional movement, landing mechanics, and dynamic balance following TRX training in physically active athletes after ACL reconstruction: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial investigated the impact of TRX training on functional movement, landing mechanics, and dynamic balance in physically active athletes following ACL reconstruction, suggesting improvements in these areas.
items.curatedReason: TRX训练对ACL重建术后运动员的功能性运动、着陆力学和动态平衡都有改善。鉴于这是一项RCT且得分75分，我们有理由相信TRX可以安全有效地整合到你的ACL术后康复方案中，帮助运动员更安全地重返赛场，尤其是在运动表现方面。
items.titleZh: TRX训练对ACL重建术后活跃运动员功能性运动、着陆力学和动态平衡的改善：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验调查了TRX训练对ACL重建术后活跃运动员功能性运动、着陆力学和动态平衡的影响，结果表明这些方面有所改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: TRX training improved functional movement, landing mechanics, and dynamic balance in athletes after ACL reconstruction. Given this is an RCT with a score of 75, you can reasonably integrate TRX into your ACL post-operative rehabilitation protocols to help athletes achieve a safer return to sport, particularly regarding performance metrics.
items.limitation: 研究未提供具体的样本量和详细的效应量数据，且可能受限于特定运动员人群的适用性。
items.limitationEn: The study does not provide specific sample size or detailed effect size data, and its applicability might be limited to specific athletic populations.

items.title: Thoracolumbar fascia injury and other independent predictors of long-term residual low back pain 3 months after percutaneous kyphoplasty for thoracolumbar osteoporotic vertebral compression fractures
items.summary: A study identified thoracolumbar fascia injury and other factors as independent predictors of long-term residual low back pain 3 months after percutaneous kyphoplasty for thoracolumbar osteoporotic vertebral compression fractures.
items.curatedReason: 对行椎体成形术治疗胸腰椎骨质疏松性椎体压缩性骨折的患者，术后3个月的长期残余腰痛，胸腰筋膜损伤是一个独立的预测因素。虽然是观察研究，但这提示你在评估这类患者时，应关注筋膜损伤状况，这可能有助于更早识别高风险患者并调整康复策略。
items.titleZh: 胸腰筋膜损伤和其他独立预测因子预示经皮椎体后凸成形术后3个月的长期残余腰背痛
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，胸腰筋膜损伤及其他因素是经皮椎体后凸成形术治疗胸腰椎骨质疏松性椎体压缩性骨折后3个月长期残余腰背痛的独立预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: Thoracolumbar fascia injury is an independent predictor of long-term residual low back pain 3 months after percutaneous kyphoplasty for thoracolumbar osteoporotic vertebral compression fractures. While an observational study, this suggests you should consider fascia integrity during assessment for these patients, which may help identify high-risk individuals earlier and inform your rehabilitation strategy.
items.limitation: 研究设计为观察性，无法确立因果关系，且预测因素的准确性和临床实用性需要更多前瞻性研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study design is observational, preventing causal conclusions, and the accuracy and clinical utility of the predictors require further prospective validation.

items.title: The effect of static and dynamic core exercises on serve and spike speed in young volleyball players: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that both static and dynamic core exercises improved serve and spike speed in young volleyball players, with dynamic exercises showing greater benefits.
items.curatedReason: 核心训练在排球运动中对发球和扣球速度的影响得到了随机对照试验的验证，特别是动态核心练习表现出更好的效果。这为你设计排球运动员的力量和表现训练方案提供了基于证据的指导，建议你优先考虑动态核心训练以提升爆发力。
items.titleZh: 静态和动态核心练习对年轻排球运动员发球和扣球速度的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，静态和动态核心练习均能提高年轻排球运动员的发球和扣球速度，其中动态练习效果更佳。
items.curatedReasonEn: The impact of core training on serve and spike speed in volleyball has been validated by an RCT, with dynamic core exercises showing better effects. This provides evidence-based guidance for you when designing strength and performance training programs for volleyball players, suggesting prioritizing dynamic core training to enhance power.
items.limitation: 研究结果可能仅限于年轻排球运动员，且未详细说明不同核心训练方案的具体参数和剂量。
items.limitationEn: The study results might be limited to young volleyball players, and detailed parameters and dosages for different core training protocols were not specified.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: [Correspondence] Rethinking risk factors for global dementia prevention
items.summary: This correspondence outlines five priorities to strengthen future global dementia-prevention agendas, building on the 2024 Lancet Commission's identification of 14 modifiable risk factors that could prevent or delay nearly half of dementia cases.
items.curatedReason: 这篇通讯重申了《柳叶刀》2024 年痴呆委员会报告的广泛影响，并提出了在全球范围内强化痴呆预防议程的五项优先事项。在实践中，您应继续关注这些可干预风险因素，尤其是在资源受限的地区，这有助于您优化预防策略和患者教育。
items.titleZh: 重新思考全球痴呆预防的风险因素
items.summaryZh: 这篇通讯基于2024年《柳叶刀》痴呆委员会报告，提出了加强未来全球痴呆预防议程的五项优先事项，该报告识别了14个可干预风险因素，可预防或延缓近半数痴呆病例。
items.curatedReasonEn: This correspondence reiterates the broad impact of The Lancet 2024 Commission on dementia and outlines five priorities for strengthening the global dementia prevention agenda. In practice, you should continue to focus on these modifiable risk factors, especially in resource-limited settings, to optimize your prevention strategies and patient education.

items.title: [Viewpoint] Systematic reviews and the needs of the adolescent transgender health care field
items.summary: This viewpoint discusses the increasing number and influence of systematic reviews on gender-affirming medical treatment for adolescents, highlighting their role in shaping healthcare policies and practices amidst growing controversy.
items.curatedReason: 系统综述在青少年跨性别健康护理领域的重要性日益增加，反映出对循证实践的需求。这提示您在面对相关患者时，应关注最新的综述证据，并理解其对实践和政策的影响。
items.titleZh: 系统综述与青少年跨性别健康护理领域的需求
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章讨论了关于青少年性别肯定医疗治疗的系统综述数量和影响日益增加，强调了它们在日益增长的争议中塑造医疗政策和实践的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The increasing importance of systematic reviews in adolescent transgender health care reflects the demand for evidence-based practice. This suggests that when encountering such patients, you should pay attention to the latest review evidence and understand its impact on practice and policy.

items.title: Development and psychometric validation of the shoulder problems assessment scale.
items.summary: This multicenter study developed and validated the 12-item Shoulder Problems Assessment Scale (SPAS), an activity-based patient-reported outcome measure using a hierarchical stepwise yes/no format, with field testing on n = 415 patients.
items.curatedReason: SPAS 量表提供了评估肩部功能障碍的新工具，其分层是非是格式可能更贴近临床实践，减少患者理解和报告负担。这在肩关节康复中具临床应用潜力。
items.titleZh: 肩部问题评估量表（SPAS）的开发与心理测量学验证
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心研究开发并验证了 12 项肩部问题评估量表（SPAS），这是一种基于活动、采用分层是非格式的患者报告结局测量工具，通过对 415 名患者的现场测试进行验证。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SPAS scale provides a new tool for assessing shoulder dysfunction. Its hierarchical yes/no format may be more relevant to clinical practice, reducing patient comprehension and reporting burden. This has potential clinical application in shoulder rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究的验证主要集中在心理测量学特性，尚未有前瞻性研究评估 SPAS 量表在长期康复结局预测或指导治疗上的临床效用。
items.limitationEn: This study's validation primarily focused on psychometric properties; prospective studies evaluating SPAS's clinical utility in predicting long-term rehabilitation outcomes or guiding treatment are still needed.

items.title: Arm exercise training in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
items.summary: This umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses synthesizes findings on arm exercise training in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), screening six databases up to May 2026.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述为慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者上肢运动训练的证据等级提供了全面梳理。该综述整合了现有证据，有助于你为 COPD 患者设计更全面的肺康复方案。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病上肢运动训练：系统综述和 Meta 分析的伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 这项对系统综述和 Meta 分析的伞形综述，综合了慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者上肢运动训练的研究发现，筛选了截至 2026 年 5 月的六个数据库。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review provides a comprehensive overview of the evidence level for arm exercise training in COPD patients. By synthesizing existing evidence, it helps you design more holistic pulmonary rehabilitation programs for your COPD patients.
items.limitation: 本伞形综述的局限性在于其纳入的原始系统综述和 Meta 分析可能存在方法学异质性，且未明确指出各项干预措施的具体效应量和依从性数据。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this umbrella review is that the included original systematic reviews and meta-analyses may have methodological heterogeneity, and specific effect sizes and adherence data for various interventions were not explicitly stated.

items.title: Effects of Aquatic Tai Chi and Computer Assisted Rehabilitation Environment-Based Virtual Reality Training on Rehabilitation in Patients with Parkinson Disease: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-blind RCT with 50 Parkinson's disease patients (Hoehn-Yahr stage 2-3) compared 12 weeks of aquatic Tai Chi (n=26) versus Computer Assisted Rehabilitation Environment-based virtual reality training (n=24). Both interventions led to improvements in UPDRS-III, BBS, TUG, and 6-minute walk test.
items.curatedReason: 对于 Hoehn-Yahr 2-3 期的帕金森病患者，不必纠结在水上太极和 VR 步态训练之间，因为这项 RCT 显示两者都能有效改善平衡、步态和运动症状。选择哪种方案，更多取决于患者偏好和诊所设备。
items.titleZh: 水上太极和计算机辅助康复环境虚拟现实训练对帕金森病患者康复效果的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对50名Hoehn-Yahr 2-3期帕金森病患者的单盲RCT显示，为期12周的水上太极（n=26）与基于计算机辅助康复环境的虚拟现实训练（n=24）均能改善UPDRS-III、BBS、TUG和6分钟步行测试表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: For Parkinson's patients in Hoehn-Yahr stages 2-3, don't overthink the choice between aquatic Tai Chi and VR gait training. This RCT indicates both are effective in improving balance, gait, and motor symptoms. Your decision should primarily be based on patient preference and clinic resources.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告具体的VR训练内容和参数，可能影响结果的可重复性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report the specific VR training content and parameters, which might affect the reproducibility of the results.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Therapeutic Exercise Protocol During Hospitalization in Pediatric Oncohematological Patients: Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial with 30 oncohematological pediatric patients (8-17 years) showed that a therapeutic exercise program during hospitalization improved quality of life, muscle strength, fatigue, and functional capacity compared to a minimal active physiotherapy group.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT为儿童肿瘤住院患者早期物理治疗提供了有力证据，表明治疗性运动程序能显著改善患儿生活质量、肌肉力量和功能能力。在临床实践中，您可以更积极地为这类高危患儿启动早期康复干预。
items.titleZh: 住院期间儿童血液肿瘤患者的治疗性运动方案：随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对30名8-17岁血液肿瘤住院患儿的随机临床试验显示，治疗性运动方案能改善生活质量、肌肉力量、疲劳和功能能力，优于最小限度的主动物理治疗对照组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT provides strong evidence for early physical therapy in hospitalized pediatric oncology patients, showing therapeutic exercise significantly improves quality of life, muscle strength, and functional capacity. In clinical practice, you can more actively initiate early rehabilitation interventions for these high-risk children.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（30名），可能限制结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size (30 participants) may limit the generalizability of the results.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Neuralgic Amyotrophy Following Rotator Cuff Repair: A Patient's Experience.
items.summary: A 64-year-old male developed severe periscapular pain and marked shoulder weakness eight days after rotator cuff repair, diagnosed as neuralgic amyotrophy. Prolonged, progressive physical therapy led to substantial functional recovery, allowing him to resume modified climbing at one year.
items.curatedReason: 这篇病例报告强调了肩袖修复术后神经性肌萎缩（NA）这种罕见但可能致残的并发症。它提醒您，术后持续剧烈疼痛和无力时，除了常见原因，还要考虑NA等神经病变，并通过长期康复帮助患者恢复功能。
items.titleZh: 肩袖修复术后神经性肌萎缩：一例患者的经验
items.summaryZh: 一名64岁男性在肩袖修复术后8天出现严重的肩胛周疼痛和明显肩部无力，诊断为神经性肌萎缩。经过长期渐进式物理治疗，患者功能恢复显著，一年后能进行改良攀爬。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report highlights neuralgic amyotrophy (NA) as a rare but potentially debilitating complication after rotator cuff repair. It reminds you to consider neuropathies like NA in cases of severe persistent pain and weakness post-op, beyond common causes, and to support patients with long-term rehabilitation for functional recovery.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, limiting the generalizability of its conclusions.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Remote Therapeutic Monitoring at a Turning Point

items.curatedReasonEn: The proposed changes to Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM) in the 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule could significantly restrict physical therapists' ability to provide RTM through contracted clinical support models. Closely monitor the final rule.

items.title: Federated learning for privacy-preserving collaborative health risk classification using wearable sensor data: validation study with elite football training load monitoring
items.summary: A validation study demonstrated that federated learning can facilitate privacy-preserving collaborative health risk classification using wearable sensor data, with applications in elite football training load monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 联邦学习模式有望通过共享匿名可穿戴传感器数据，实现更准确的健康风险预测，但其在临床实践中的效果和转化仍需更多研究验证。
items.titleZh: 利用可穿戴传感器数据进行隐私保护协作健康风险分类的联邦学习：精英足球训练负荷监测验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项验证性研究表明，联邦学习能够利用可穿戴传感器数据，在保护隐私的前提下实现协作式健康风险分类，并可应用于精英足球运动员的训练负荷监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: Federated learning shows promise in improving health risk prediction by sharing anonymized wearable sensor data, but its clinical effectiveness and translation require further validation.
items.limitation: 本研究为验证性研究，主要评估了联邦学习模式的可行性，尚未在真实临床环境中大规模验证其健康风险预测的准确性和临床益处。
items.limitationEn: This validation study primarily assessed the feasibility of federated learning; its accuracy in health risk prediction and clinical benefits have not been extensively validated in real-world clinical settings.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across different movement patterns in amateur soccer players
items.summary: This study investigated repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across different movement patterns in amateur soccer players, providing insights for optimized training.
items.curatedReason: 了解不同运动模式下重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应的差异，可优化足球运动员的训练计划和疲劳管理策略，提升运动表现。
items.titleZh: 业余足球运动员不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现与疲劳反应
items.summaryZh: 本研究调查了业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应，为优化训练提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding the differences in repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across various movement patterns can optimize training programs and fatigue management strategies for soccer players, improving athletic performance.
items.limitation: 该研究针对业余足球运动员，结果在其他运动类型或专业运动员中的普适性尚需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This study focused on amateur soccer players; the generalizability of its findings to other sports or professional athletes requires further validation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Beyond treatment: how care process factors shape physical therapist management of low back pain.
items.summary: This commentary synthesizes evidence on how care process factors, such as timing of care, point of entry, care pathway design, and insurance models, shape physical therapist management of low back pain and influence patient outcomes independently of specific treatments.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调，低背痛患者的护理过程因素（如就医时机、首诊类型、医保模式）对疗效有独立影响。别只盯着治疗方案，优化这些流程因素也是提升疗效的关键。
items.titleZh: 超越治疗：护理过程因素如何影响物理治疗师对低背痛的管理
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评综合了现有证据，探讨了就医时机、首诊类型、护理路径设计和医保模式等护理过程因素，如何独立于具体治疗干预之外，影响物理治疗师对低背痛的管理及患者疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights that care process factors (e.g., timing of care, initial provider type, insurance models) independently influence outcomes for low back pain patients. Don't just focus on treatment protocols; optimizing these process factors is also crucial for improving outcomes.
items.limitation: 本篇为述评，仅基于现有证据进行探讨和呼吁，未提供新的实证数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary, exploring existing evidence and advocating for certain considerations without providing new empirical data.

items.title: Minimal Detectable Change in Gait Biomechanics Post-Stroke: Disentangling the Effects of Walking Speed and Stroke-Related Variability
items.summary: This study quantified intra-class correlation coefficients (ICC) and minimal detectable change (MDC) in gait biomechanics for N=15 post-stroke individuals and N=13 neurotypical controls walking at matched speeds, isolating the impact of gait speed and stroke-related impairments on gait-analysis reliability.
items.curatedReason: 本研究量化了卒中后步态生物力学测量的最小可检测变化（MDC），并区分了步行速度和卒中相关变异性的影响。这些 MDC 值是解读卒中患者步态分析结果、评估干预效果的重要参考。
items.titleZh: 卒中后步态生物力学测量的最小可检测变化：区分步行速度与卒中相关变异性的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项研究量化了 N=15 名卒中后个体和 N=13 名神经典型对照在匹配速度下步行时的步态生物力学内部相关系数（ICC）和最小可检测变化（MDC），以分离步行速度和卒中相关损伤对步态分析可靠性的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study quantified the minimal detectable change (MDC) in gait biomechanics post-stroke, distinguishing the effects of walking speed and stroke-related variability. These MDC values are crucial for interpreting gait analysis results and evaluating intervention efficacy in stroke patients.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（卒中组 N=15，对照组 N=13），且仅在跑步机上进行，可能限制结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (N=15 post-stroke, N=13 controls) and was conducted only on a treadmill, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Methods for assessing core muscle co-activation in the lumbar region: a narrative review.
items.summary: This narrative review critically appraises current methods for assessing lumbar core muscle co-activation, categorizing approaches into surface electromyography and co-contraction index calculation, focusing on their theoretical basis, technical characteristics, interpretive value, limitations, and practical applicability.
items.curatedReason: 评估腰部核心肌群协同激活时，需要警惕表面肌电图和协同收缩指数的局限性。这篇综述提醒我们，现有方法在理论基础、技术特点和临床解读上仍存在诸多挑战，别轻易下定论。
items.titleZh: 评估腰部核心肌群协同激活的方法：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述批判性地评估了当前评估腰部核心肌群协同激活的方法，将其分为表面肌电图和协同收缩指数计算等类别，并重点分析了其理论基础、技术特点、解释价值、局限性和实践适用性。
items.curatedReasonEn: When assessing lumbar core muscle co-activation, be wary of the limitations of surface EMG and co-contraction indices. This review highlights that current methods still face numerous challenges in theoretical basis, technical characteristics, and clinical interpretation; do not draw firm conclusions easily.
items.limitation: 本篇为叙述性综述，可能未进行全面的系统性文献检索和质量评估，存在潜在偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may not have performed a comprehensive systematic literature search and quality appraisal, leading to potential biases.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Physiotherapist-led care for musculoskeletal conditions in the emergency department (RESHAP-ED): a randomised controlled trial with economic evaluation.
items.summary: The RESHAP-ED pragmatic RCT evaluated physiotherapist-led care for musculoskeletal conditions in five Australian emergency departments, demonstrating improved effectiveness, safety, and cost-effectiveness compared to usual care.
items.curatedReason: 这项在澳大利亚急诊科进行的 RCT 明确显示，物理治疗师主导的医疗模式可有效缩短患者在急诊科的等待时间，并降低医疗费用。在你的执业实践中，这进一步支持了 PT 在急诊分流中的重要作用。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师主导的急诊科肌肉骨骼疾病诊疗模式（RESHAP-ED）：一项随机对照试验及经济学评价
items.summaryZh: RESHAP-ED 是一项开放标签、实用性随机试验，在澳大利亚新南威尔士州的五个急诊科招募了肌肉骨骼疾病患者。该研究比较了物理治疗师主导的诊疗模式与常规护理的有效性、安全性及成本效益，结果显示物理治疗师主导的模式表现更优。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT from Australian emergency departments clearly shows that physiotherapist-led care effectively reduces ED length of stay and healthcare costs. In practice, this further supports the crucial role of PTs in emergency department triage.
items.limitation: 研究在澳大利亚新南威尔士州的五个急诊科进行，结果的外推性可能受限于特定医疗系统和地区。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted in five emergency departments in New South Wales, Australia, so the generalizability of the findings may be limited by the specific healthcare system and region.

items.title: Effects of short-term compression in people with knee osteoarthritis: A sham-controlled randomised trial.
items.summary: A three-arm sham-controlled RCT (n=90) found that short-term elastic bandage compression did not significantly improve pain or physical function in knee osteoarthritis patients compared to sham compression or no bandaging at Day 6, 12 or 24 weeks post-intervention.
items.curatedReason: 本项 RCT 发现膝关节骨性关节炎患者短期使用弹性绷带进行压迫，在疼痛和功能改善方面不优于安慰性压迫或无压迫。在实践中，它提示你无需将压迫疗法作为 OA 的常规干预手段。
items.titleZh: 短期压迫疗法对膝骨关节炎患者的效果：一项假对照随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项三臂假对照随机对照试验（n=90）发现，在为期 6 天的干预后，短期弹性绷带压迫疗法在膝关节骨性关节炎患者的疼痛强度和身体功能方面，未显示出优于安慰性压迫或无压带的显著改善，且效果在 12 和 24 周后亦未显现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that short-term knee compression with elastic bandages did not offer superior pain or function improvement compared to sham compression or no bandaging in knee OA patients. It suggests that compression therapy is not a primary intervention for OA.
items.limitation: 本研究的随访期较长（24 周），但短期（6 天）干预的效果未能持续。
items.limitationEn: Although the follow-up period was long (24 weeks), the short-term (6-day) intervention effects did not persist.

items.title: A qualitative inquiry into the environmental barriers and facilitators to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guideline adherence among Canadian physiotherapists.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored environmental barriers and facilitators influencing Canadian physiotherapists' adherence to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guidelines, identifying factors across public and private sectors.
items.curatedReason: 非特异性腰痛指南依从性差？这项定性研究发现，加拿大物理治疗师在依从指南时面临的障碍与促成因素，公立和私立部门都有其特点。这提示我们，优化本地诊所的指南依从性，需细致考量具体执业环境。
items.titleZh: 加拿大物理治疗师依从非特异性腰痛临床实践指南的环境障碍与促成因素定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究深入探讨了加拿大物理治疗师在公共和私营部门执业中，依从非特异性腰痛临床实践指南所面临的环境障碍和促成因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Poor adherence to non-specific low back pain guidelines? This qualitative study reveals specific environmental barriers and facilitators faced by Canadian PTs, with differences noted across public and private sectors. To improve guideline adherence in your local clinic, you'll need to consider your specific practice environment carefully.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，且结果可能受到研究者偏倚的影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size, and the findings may be influenced by researcher bias.

items.title: Revisional augmentation of residual neuromusculature and training facilitate embodiment and control of a bionic knee prosthesis
items.summary: This interventional study with two individuals with above-knee amputation showed that surgical revision to restore agonist-antagonist muscle relationships, combined with bionic knee prosthesis training, improved embodiment, control, and sensorimotor integration.
items.curatedReason: 对于大腿截肢患者，这项针对 2 人的研究提示，通过手术重建拮抗肌群关系并结合仿生膝假肢训练，可显著提升躯体感知、控制力及感觉运动整合。虽然样本量小，但这为未来仿生假肢和神经接口的整合提供了明确方向。
items.titleZh: 残留神经肌肉的翻修增强和训练促进了仿生膝关节假体的具身化和控制
items.summaryZh: 这项对两名膝上截肢者的介入性研究表明，通过手术翻修重建残余肌肉的激动-拮抗关系，并结合仿生膝关节假体训练，显著改善了假体的具身化、控制和感觉运动整合。
items.curatedReasonEn: For above-knee amputees, this 2-person study suggests that surgical revision to restore agonist-antagonist muscle relationships, combined with bionic knee prosthesis training, can significantly improve embodiment, control, and sensorimotor integration. Though a small sample, it points to a clear direction for integrating bionic prosthetics and neural interfaces.
items.limitation: 本研究仅涉及两名膝上截肢者，样本量极小，且为初步的介入性研究，结果的普适性需要更多大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This study involved only two above-knee amputees, representing an extremely small sample size and a preliminary interventional study, so the generalizability of the results requires validation by larger-scale research.

items.title: Selective differences in eccentric inter-limb mechanics during single-leg vertical jump six months after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=44) investigated eccentric inter-limb mechanics during single-leg vertical jumps six months post-ACLR, identifying selective differences in peak eccentric force, impulse, and velocity compared to controls.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究揭示了 ACLR 术后 6 个月单腿跳跃中患肢与健肢的离心力学差异，这进一步强调了双侧不对称对重返运动的潜在风险。将其作为你评估 ACLR 患者重返运动准备情况时的参考依据。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后六个月单腿垂直跳跃中患健肢离心力学的选择性差异
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察研究（n=44）调查了前交叉韧带重建术后六个月单腿垂直跳跃时的患健肢离心力学特征，发现患肢在峰值离心力、离心冲量和离心速度上存在选择性差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study reveals eccentric inter-limb mechanical differences during single-leg jumps 6 months post-ACLR, highlighting potential risks from bilateral asymmetry for return to sport. Use this as a reference when assessing ACLR patients' readiness for return to sport.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于男性参与者，且仅在 ACLR 术后 6 个月进行了一次评估，可能无法反映长期变化和更广泛人群的特点。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to male participants and only assessed at 6 months post-ACLR, which may not reflect long-term changes or broader population characteristics.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Clinical Decision Making in Pediatric Physiotherapy: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review mapped the literature on clinical decision-making in pediatric physiotherapy (ages 0-18), identifying frameworks and factors influencing therapists' decisions across 22 studies.
items.curatedReason: 儿科物理治疗的临床决策复杂性高，这篇综述总结了 22 项研究，勾勒出影响儿科治疗师决策的框架和关键因素。在评估和干预 0-18 岁患者时，需特别关注发育差异性和以家庭为中心的护理。
items.titleZh: 儿科物理治疗中的临床决策：一项范围界定性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围界定性综述绘制了儿科物理治疗（0-18岁）中临床决策的文献图谱，识别了研究中使用的框架以及影响治疗师决策的因素，共纳入 22 项研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pediatric clinical decision-making is complex. This scoping review, synthesizing 22 studies, outlines frameworks and key factors influencing therapists' decisions for ages 0-18. When assessing and intervening with this population, prioritize developmental variability and family-centered care.
items.limitation: 作为范围界定性综述，它主要描绘了文献现状，并未对证据质量进行严格评估或提供综合结论。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, it primarily maps the literature and does not rigorously assess evidence quality or provide synthesized conclusions.

items.title: RObotic WAlking for children who CAnnot WAlk (RoWaCaWa): Impacts on Physical Function and Physical Activity from a 12-week robotic walking intervention
items.summary: A single-arm mixed-methods interventional study examined the impact of 12 weeks of robotic walking on physical function and inactivity sequelae in children with pediatric-onset neuromotor impairments, using outcomes like Goal Attainment Scale and physical activity measures.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对不能行走的儿童的机器人步态训练研究，提示了 12 周干预对身体功能和活动水平的改善。对于患有神经运动障碍的儿童，这进一步支持了机器人辅助训练在改善步态、实现康复目标中的应用潜力。
items.titleZh: RObotic WAlking for children who CAnnot WAlk (RoWaCaWa)：12 周机器人步态干预对身体功能和身体活动的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项单臂混合方法干预性研究，旨在探讨 12 周机器人步态训练对患有儿科神经运动障碍、无法行走的儿童的身体功能和不活动后遗症的影响，并采用目标达成量表和身体活动测量等指标进行评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This robotic walking study for children who cannot walk suggests improvements in physical function and activity levels after a 12-week intervention. For children with neuromotor impairments, this further supports the potential of robot-assisted training in improving gait and achieving rehabilitation goals.
items.limitation: 本研究为单臂混合方法干预性研究，缺乏对照组，因此无法确定观察到的改善是否直接归因于机器人步态训练。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-arm mixed-methods interventional study without a control group, so the observed improvements cannot be definitively attributed to robotic walking intervention.

items.title: How Clinics Can Support Their Billing Teams in the Era of Payer Complexity
items.summary: This WebPT blog post discusses strategies for clinics to support their billing teams amidst increasing payer complexity, aiming to optimize reimbursement processes and operational efficiency.
items.curatedReason: 在支付方规则日益复杂的当下，WebPT 这篇博文提醒我们，诊所必须有效支持其账单团队。你需要审视诊所的报销流程，并考虑如何通过优化管理来提高运营效率，以确保收入最大化。
items.titleZh: 诊所如何在支付方日益复杂的时代支持其账单团队
items.summaryZh: WebPT 的这篇博客文章探讨了在支付方复杂性不断增加的背景下，诊所应如何支持其账单团队，旨在优化报销流程和提高运营效率。
items.curatedReasonEn: With increasing payer complexity, this WebPT blog post underscores the necessity for clinics to effectively support their billing teams. You should review your clinic's reimbursement processes and consider optimizing management to enhance operational efficiency and maximize revenue.
items.limitation: 这是一篇博客文章，内容基于行业经验和观点，而非严谨的研究证据或官方政策变动，因此其建议可能不具备普适性和权威性。
items.limitationEn: This is a blog post based on industry experience and opinions, not rigorous research evidence or official policy changes, so its recommendations may not be universally applicable or authoritative.

items.title: Outcome measures used in studies of vestibular rehabilitation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified outcome measures used in vestibular rehabilitation for adults with stroke, searching MEDLINE, Embase, and PEDro up to June 2026. It mapped and grouped outcomes by primary construct, calculating the frequency of use for each measure.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述提供了中风后前庭康复结局测量的概览，但强调了其异质性。在设计临床研究或选择疗效评估工具时，这有助于你避免“只关注步行”的偏见，确保评估的全面性。
items.titleZh: 中风后前庭康复研究中使用的结局测量指标：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述系统检索了截至2026年6月的中风成人前庭康复研究，旨在识别和映射所使用的结局测量指标。研究根据主要结构对结局进行分组，并计算了各测量指标的使用频率。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review provides an overview of outcome measures in vestibular rehabilitation post-stroke, highlighting their heterogeneity. This helps you avoid a 'walking-only' bias when designing studies or selecting assessment tools, ensuring comprehensive evaluation.
items.limitation: 本综述未对各结局测量工具的测量学特性（如信效度）进行评估。
items.limitationEn: This review did not evaluate the psychometric properties (e.g., reliability, validity) of the outcome measures.

items.title: Beyond Conventional Therapy in Parkinson's Disease Patients: The Impact of Visual Feedback Training on Balance and Trunk Control - A Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A 4-week program combining conventional physiotherapy with visual-feedback balance and trunk-control training improved balance, mobility, and functional independence in 21 Parkinson's disease patients (Hoehn and Yahr stages 1-3).
items.curatedReason: 将视觉反馈训练与常规物理治疗结合，可改善帕金森病患者的平衡和躯干控制。将其作为你工具箱的补充选项，特别是对于姿势不稳和跌倒风险高的患者。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者超越传统疗法：视觉反馈训练对平衡和躯干控制的影响——一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 4 周、结合常规物理治疗与视觉反馈平衡和躯干控制训练的项目，改善了 21 名帕金森病（Hoehn and Yahr 1-3 期）患者的平衡、活动能力和功能独立性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Combining visual feedback training with conventional physiotherapy can improve balance and trunk control in Parkinson's disease patients. Consider this as a supplementary option in your toolkit, especially for those with high postural instability and fall risk.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心前瞻性队列研究，样本量小，且缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center prospective cohort study with a small sample size and no control group, preventing exclusion of placebo effects.

items.title: Measurement properties of a 300-m community-based walking test incorporating environmental walking demands in individuals with subacute stroke.
items.summary: The 300-m Community-Based Walking Test (CBWT) demonstrated good test-retest reliability (ICC 2,1 ≥ 0.94) and small minimal detectable change (≤ 16.5 m) in 26 individuals with subacute stroke, reflecting environmental walking demands.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究验证了 300 米社区步行测试（CBWT）在亚急性卒中患者中的可靠性，为你评估患者在真实环境中的步行能力提供了有效的工具。
items.titleZh: 纳入环境步行需求的 300 米社区步行测试在亚急性卒中患者中的测量学特性
items.summaryZh: 一项研究评估了 26 名亚急性卒中患者的 300 米社区步行测试（CBWT）的测量学特性，显示出良好的重测信度（ICC 2,1 ≥ 0.94）和小的最小可检测变化（≤ 16.5 米），能反映环境步行需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validates the reliability of the 300-m Community-Based Walking Test (CBWT) in subacute stroke patients, offering you an effective tool for assessing real-world walking ability.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性分析前瞻性数据的研究，样本量有限，且未提供关于测试对治疗效果敏感性的信息。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data had a limited sample size and did not provide information on the test's responsiveness to treatment effects.

items.title: Atlantoaxial Instability in older adults: an underrecognized condition beyond rheumatoid arthritis – a retrospective study
items.summary: This retrospective study highlights atlantoaxial instability (AAI) as an underrecognized condition in older adults beyond rheumatoid arthritis, suggesting a need for increased awareness and evaluation in this population.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究提醒你关注老年人寰枢关节不稳（AAI）的问题，它可能在类风湿关节炎之外被低估。对于伴有颈部症状或跌倒风险的老年患者，要将 AAI 纳入鉴别诊断，进行更细致的评估。
items.titleZh: 老年人寰枢关节不稳：一个在类风湿关节炎之外未被充分认识的状况——一项回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究强调，寰枢关节不稳（AAI）是老年人群中除类风湿关节炎外一个未被充分认识的状况，提示需要提高对该人群 AAI 的认知和评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study reminds you to pay attention to atlantoaxial instability (AAI) in older adults, which might be underrecognized beyond rheumatoid arthritis. For elderly patients with neck symptoms or fall risk, include AAI in your differential diagnosis and conduct a more thorough assessment.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性研究，存在回顾性偏倚，且未提供治疗干预效果的数据。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective study, subject to recall bias, and did not provide data on the effectiveness of therapeutic interventions.

items.title: Effect of Global Postural Re-Education in Individuals With Text Neck Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=60) found that Global Postural Re-Education (GPR) combined with conventional physical therapy significantly improved craniovertebral/shoulder angles, pain (VAS), and cervical ROM compared to conventional therapy alone in individuals with text neck syndrome.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，对于体态性颈痛，GPR 联合常规疗法可能在改善颈肩角度、缓解疼痛和增加活动度方面优于单独的常规疗法。这支持将 GPR 作为现有方案的补充。
items.titleZh: 姿势再教育对“低头族”颈痛综合征患者疗效的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=60）发现，对于“低头族”颈痛综合征患者，全局姿势再教育（GPR）联合常规物理治疗在改善颈椎和肩部角度、疼痛（VAS）以及颈椎活动度方面，显著优于单独常规物理治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that GPR combined with conventional therapy may be superior to conventional therapy alone for text neck syndrome, improving craniovertebral and shoulder angles, pain, and ROM. This supports GPR as a complementary approach to existing protocols.
items.limitation: 本研究为单盲设计，且随访期较短（4周），可能未能捕捉长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The study was single-blinded with a short 4-week follow-up, which may not capture long-term effects.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Nutrition in Osteoarthritis care: expanding the physical therapist's role in multimodal management.
items.summary: An editorial suggests that physical therapists should expand their role in osteoarthritis care to include nutrition screening and lifestyle interventions, recognizing OA as a multifactorial disease beyond just mechanical wear-and-tear.
items.curatedReason: 由于骨关节炎的炎症和代谢背景日益明确，物理治疗师需要拓宽职责范围，将营养筛查和生活方式干预纳入多模式管理。将营养咨询整合到常规实践中，能为患者提供更全面的康复方案。
items.titleZh: 骨关节炎管理中的营养：物理治疗师在多模式管理中角色拓展
items.summaryZh: 一篇社论建议，物理治疗师应扩大在骨关节炎护理中的作用，将营养筛查和生活方式干预纳入多模式管理，因为骨关节炎不仅是机械性磨损，更是受多种因素影响的疾病。
items.curatedReasonEn: Given the growing understanding of OA's inflammatory and metabolic underpinnings, physical therapists should expand their role to include nutrition screening and lifestyle interventions in multimodal management. Integrating nutrition counseling into practice can offer a more comprehensive rehabilitation approach for patients.

items.title: Have conflicts of interest in manual therapy trials for low back pain been transparent? A meta-epidemiological review.
items.summary: A meta-epidemiological review of manual therapy trials for low back pain published between 2000 and 2025 found that conflicts of interest were often inadequately disclosed when compared to external searches.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃流行病学研究揭示了手法治疗腰痛试验中利益冲突披露的普遍不足。在评估手法治疗研究的证据时，务必审慎查阅外部资金来源和潜在的利益冲突，因为这些可能影响研究结果的透明度和可信度。
items.titleZh: 腰痛手法治疗试验中利益冲突披露的透明度：一项荟萃流行病学综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 2000 至 2025 年间发表的腰痛手法治疗试验的荟萃流行病学综述发现，与外部查询结果相比，研究中利益冲突的披露普遍不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-epidemiological review highlights widespread under-disclosure of conflicts of interest (COI) in manual therapy trials for low back pain. When evaluating evidence for manual therapy studies, meticulously examine external funding sources and potential COIs, as these can impact the transparency and credibility of study findings.
items.limitation: 该综述仅限于 2000-2025 年间发表的英文试验，可能未能覆盖所有相关研究。
items.limitationEn: This review was limited to English trials published between 2000 and 2025, potentially not covering all relevant studies.

items.title: Focal Muscle Vibration for Upper Limb Spasticity After Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of studies (inception-March 2026) involving adults with post-stroke upper limb spasticity found focal muscle vibration (FMV) has a significant effect (Hedges' g=0.74, 95% CI 0.52-0.97) on reducing spasticity.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析基本坐实了局部肌肉振动对卒中后上肢痉挛的积极效果，其效应量为中等。现在你可以更放心地将 FMV 作为辅助干预手段纳入上肢痉挛的康复方案。
items.titleZh: 局灶性肌肉振动对卒中后上肢痉挛的影响：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（截至 2026 年 3 月）发现，局灶性肌肉振动 (FMV) 对卒中后上肢痉挛有显著效果 (Hedges' g=0.74, 95% CI 0.52-0.97)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis largely confirms the positive effect of focal muscle vibration on post-stroke upper limb spasticity, with a moderate effect size (Hedges' g=0.74). You can now more confidently incorporate FMV as an adjunctive intervention in rehabilitation programs for upper limb spasticity.
items.limitation: 异质性分析或不同频率/幅度的具体效果未在摘要中详细说明。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity analysis or specific effects of different frequencies/amplitudes were not detailed in the abstract.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: The Optimal Exercise Modality and Dose for Blood Pressure Management in Middle-Aged and Older Adults: A Systematic Review with Bayesian Model-Based, and Dose-Response Network Meta-Analysis of RCTs.
items.summary: This systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis of RCTs identified optimal exercise modalities and doses for lowering resting systolic and diastolic BP in middle-aged and older adults (≥45 years) by May 2025.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述通过贝叶斯网络荟萃分析，清晰地比较了不同运动模式和剂量对中老年高血压的降压效果。它能让你更精准地为中老年患者推荐运动处方，尤其是针对最佳降压效果的运动类型和强度。
items.titleZh: 中老年高血压患者血压管理的最优运动模式和剂量：一项基于贝叶斯模型和剂量反应网络荟萃分析的 RCT 系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项对随机对照试验进行的系统综述和贝叶斯网络荟萃分析，识别了截至 2025 年 5 月中老年（≥45 岁）高血压患者降低静息收缩压和舒张压的最优运动模式和剂量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis clearly compare the blood pressure-lowering effects of different exercise modalities and doses in middle-aged and older adults. This means you can more precisely recommend exercise prescriptions for patients ≥45 years old, especially regarding the optimal exercise type and intensity for blood pressure reduction, avoiding a 'one-size-fits-all' approach.
items.limitation: 剂量-反应分析的细节和异质性来源未在摘要中详细说明。
items.limitationEn: Details of the dose-response analysis and sources of heterogeneity were not elaborated in the abstract.

items.title: Prestroke Rehabilitation Reserve and Mobility and Self-Care Outcomes After Incident Stroke Across Four International Aging Cohorts.
items.summary: A harmonized longitudinal cohort study (N=7486, mean age 70.0 years) across four international aging cohorts found that lower multidimensional pre-stroke rehabilitation reserve was associated with adverse mobility and self-care status after incident stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项跨国队列研究强调了卒中前康复储备的重要性。它证实了较低的储备与卒中后更差的移动和自理能力相关，提示我们需要更重视早期识别和干预，以增强患者的整体康复潜力。
items.titleZh: 卒中前康复储备与卒中后移动和自理能力结局在四个国际老年队列中的关系
items.summaryZh: 一项在四个国际老年队列中进行的统一纵向队列研究（N=7486，平均年龄 70.0 岁）发现，多维度卒中前康复储备较低与卒中后不利的移动和自理能力状况相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multinational cohort study underscores the importance of pre-stroke rehabilitation reserve. It confirms that lower reserve is associated with poorer mobility and self-care outcomes after stroke, suggesting a need for greater emphasis on early identification and intervention to enhance overall rehabilitation potential.
items.limitation: 由于是观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且康复储备的衡量可能受文化和环境因素影响。
items.limitationEn: As an observational study, it cannot establish causality, and the measurement of rehabilitation reserve may be influenced by cultural and environmental factors.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Prestroke Rehabilitation Reserve and Mobility and Self-Care Outcomes After Incident Stroke Across Four International Aging Cohorts

items.title: Responsiveness, Smallest Detectable Change, and Minimal Important Change of the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 Following Pelvic Floor Muscle Training.
items.summary: This multicenter, retrospective study (N=200 women) determined the responsiveness, smallest detectable change (SDC), and minimal important change (MIC) of the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 (PFDI-20) following an 8-week pelvic floor muscle training intervention.
items.curatedReason: 土耳其语版 PFDI-20 量表的响应度、SDC 和 MIC 数据现已明确。这意味着你在评估土耳其患者盆底肌训练效果时，能更精确地判断临床上有意义的变化，避免过度解读微小波动。
items.titleZh: 盆底肌训练后土耳其语版盆底困扰量表-20 (PFDI-20) 的响应度、最小可检测变化和最小重要变化
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心回顾性研究（N=200 名女性）评估了土耳其语版盆底困扰量表-20 (PFDI-20) 在经过 8 周盆底肌训练后的响应度、最小可检测变化 (SDC) 和最小重要变化 (MIC)。
items.curatedReasonEn: The responsiveness, SDC, and MIC data for the Turkish PFDI-20 scale are now clear. This means you can more accurately determine clinically meaningful changes when assessing the effectiveness of pelvic floor muscle training in Turkish-speaking patients, avoiding over-interpretation of minor fluctuations.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性设计，可能存在选择偏倚和数据完整性问题。
items.limitationEn: This study used a retrospective design, which may be subject to selection bias and data completeness issues.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Relief increases select shoulder muscle activity, following subacromial injection in subacromial pain syndrome.
items.summary: This study (N=21) found that subacromial injection, which reduced pain, immediately increased activity in select shoulder muscles during humeral elevation in individuals with subacromial pain syndrome.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，亚肩峰注射缓解疼痛后，患者特定肩部肌肉的激活模式会立即改变，这提示疼痛管理在优化肩部神经肌肉功能中扮演了重要角色。
items.titleZh: 亚肩峰疼痛综合征患者亚肩峰注射缓解疼痛后，特定肩部肌肉活动度增加
items.summaryZh: 这项研究（N=21）发现，亚肩峰疼痛综合征患者在亚肩峰注射缓解疼痛后，其肱骨抬高过程中特定肩部肌肉的活动度立即增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that pain relief following subacromial injection immediately alters activation patterns of select shoulder muscles, suggesting that pain management plays a crucial role in optimizing shoulder neuromuscular function.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小 (N=21)，且存在 EMG 信号变异性问题。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (N=21) and issues with EMG signal variability.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Characteristics of Classified Gait Pattern Subgroups and Definitions of Abnormal Gait Patterns Following Stroke: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: This scoping review comprehensively explored the existing characteristics of classified gait pattern subgroups following stroke, highlighting the uncertainty in current definitions despite the importance of individualized gait training.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后偏瘫步态的分类远未明晰。尽管这项综述未能提供新的定义，但它指出了现有分类框架的局限性，提示我们不能盲目套用现有模式，个体化评估仍是关键。
items.titleZh: 卒中后分类步态模式亚组特征及异常步态模式定义：范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述全面探讨了卒中后分类步态模式亚组的现有特征，强调了尽管个体化步态训练至关重要，但当前定义仍存在不确定性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stroke hemiplegic gait classification remains unclear. While this review doesn't offer new definitions, it highlights the limitations of existing frameworks, suggesting we shouldn't blindly apply current models; individualized assessment remains crucial.
items.limitation: 本综述识别了现有分类方法的异质性和不确定性，但未提供具体的量化数据来指导临床决策。
items.limitationEn: The review identified heterogeneity and uncertainty in existing classification methods but did not provide specific quantitative data to guide clinical decisions.

items.title: Advancing Payment: What the Proposed 2027 Medicare Fee Schedule Means for PTs
items.summary: APTA has released an analysis of the proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule, highlighting key provisions affecting physical therapists' payment and practice, with a call for member comments by Sept. 14.
items.curatedReason: APTA发布了关于2027年Medicare医师收费标准拟议规则的分析，直接关系到你在美国的报销和执业模式。务必利用9月14日前的窗口期，向CMS提交你的反馈意见，影响最终政策制定。
items.titleZh: 推进支付：2027年Medicare收费标准拟议对物理治疗师的意义
items.summaryZh: APTA发布了对2027年Medicare医师收费标准拟议规则的分析，强调了影响物理治疗师支付和执业的关键条款，并呼吁会员在9月14日前提交意见。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA has released an analysis on the proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule, directly impacting your reimbursement and practice model in the U.S. Ensure you submit your feedback to CMS before the September 14 deadline to influence final policy-making.

items.title: Effects of functional versus conventional Physiotherapy-Based pain management on symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 28 women with Bladder Pain Syndrome (BPS) found that a functional physiotherapy program (pain science education, cognition-targeted exercises, relaxation) significantly improved symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life compared to conventional physiotherapy (TENS, manual therapy, strengthening).
items.curatedReason: 功能性物理治疗对膀胱疼痛综合征患者的益处显著，优于传统疗法。尽管样本量只有 28 人，但其生物心理社会整合干预的成功，提示我们应优先考虑疼痛科学教育和认知训练。
items.titleZh: 功能性与传统物理治疗对膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者症状、心理结局及生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验纳入28名膀胱疼痛综合征（BPS）女性患者，结果显示功能性物理治疗（疼痛科学教育、认知导向练习、放松练习）在改善症状、心理结局和生活质量方面优于传统物理治疗（TENS、手法治疗、肌力训练）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Functional physiotherapy significantly outperforms conventional methods for Bladder Pain Syndrome. Although the RCT only included 28 women, its success with a biopsychosocial integrated intervention suggests prioritizing pain science education and cognitive-targeted exercises.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（28名女性），且为单中心研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (28 women) and was a single-center study, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Acute effects of squat and core exercises using elastic bands on post-activation performance enhancement in tennis players: control, randomized, crossover trials
items.summary: This randomized, crossover trial investigated the acute effects of squat and core exercises using elastic bands on post-activation performance enhancement (PAPE) in tennis players, finding beneficial outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，对于网球运动员，使用弹力带的深蹲和核心训练可以提高赛后激活表现。这意味着你可以在缺乏重阻力器械时，考虑将弹力带训练作为一种有效的赛前热身或训练方案。
items.titleZh: 弹力带深蹲和核心训练对网球运动员赛后激活表现的急性影响：随机交叉对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机交叉对照试验研究了使用弹力带进行深蹲和核心练习对网球运动员赛后激活表现（PAPE）的急性影响，发现有益结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that squat and core exercises using elastic bands can enhance post-activation performance in tennis players. This implies you can consider elastic band training as an effective pre-match warm-up or training alternative when heavy resistance equipment is unavailable.
items.limitation: 研究未明确提供具体的样本量和效果量数据，可能影响结果的精确解读。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly provide specific sample size and effect size data, which may affect the precise interpretation of the results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson’s disease: an exploratory analysis
items.summary: An exploratory analysis investigated the effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson's disease, suggesting potential neurobiological benefits.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性分析提示，多学科强化门诊康复项目可能通过影响血浆神经丝和肌因子，对帕金森病患者产生积极的神经生物学效应。这为康复干预的机制研究提供了新的方向。
items.titleZh: 多学科强化门诊康复项目对帕金森病患者血浆神经丝和肌因子的影响：一项探索性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性分析研究了多学科强化门诊康复项目对帕金森病患者血浆神经丝和肌因子的影响，提示可能存在神经生物学益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory analysis suggests that multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation programs might exert positive neurobiological effects in Parkinson's disease by influencing plasma neurofilaments and myokines. This opens new avenues for mechanistic research into rehabilitation interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性分析，样本量和干预细节未在摘要中明确，需要进一步的验证性研究。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory analysis, and details regarding sample size and intervention specifics were not explicit in the abstract, warranting further confirmatory studies.

items.title: Assessing concerns about falling: a comparison of telephone-based and face-to-face FES-I interviews in older adults
items.summary: This study compared telephone-based and face-to-face interviews using the Falls Efficacy Scale-International (FES-I) for assessing concerns about falling in older adults, providing insights into assessment methods.
items.curatedReason: FES-I 的电话评估结果与面谈评估相似。这意味着你可以更灵活地选择评估方式，但仍需留意两种方法可能存在的细微差异，确保评估的准确性。
items.titleZh: 老年人跌倒顾虑评估：电话与面谈FES-I访谈的比较
items.summaryZh: 本研究比较了电话与面对面访谈方式在老年人跌倒效能国际量表（FES-I）评估跌倒顾虑方面的效果，为评估方法提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telephone-based FES-I assessments yield similar results to face-to-face interviews. This offers flexibility in assessment methods, but you should still be mindful of potential subtle differences between the two approaches to ensure accuracy.
items.limitation: 研究结果的细节（如具体差异量、一致性指标）未在摘要中明确，需要查阅全文以评估两种评估方式的互换性。
items.limitationEn: Details of the study results (e.g., specific differences, agreement metrics) were not explicit in the abstract, requiring full text review to assess the interchangeability of the two assessment methods.

items.title: Neurology | American Board of Physical Therapy Education Residency and Fellowship
items.summary: The American Board of Physical Therapy Residency and Fellowship Education (ABPTRFE) has released a new Description of Residency Practice (DRP) for neurology to standardize curriculum and streamline accreditation for residency programs.
items.curatedReason: ABPTRFE 新发布的神经物理治疗 DRP 为住院医师项目提供了统一的课程标准。如果你负责神经康复住院医师的培训或认证，应立即参考这份文件，以确保符合最新要求并优化流程。
items.titleZh: 神经物理治疗 | 美国物理治疗教育住院医师和专科培训委员会
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗住院医师与专科培训委员会（ABPTRFE）发布了新的神经物理治疗住院医师实践描述（DRP），旨在统一课程标准并简化住院医师项目的认证流程。
items.curatedReasonEn: The new ABPTRFE neurology DRP standardizes curriculum for residency programs. If you're involved in training or accrediting neurology residents, you should consult this document immediately to ensure compliance with the latest requirements and optimize your processes.

items.title: Predicting gait patterns from actionable impairments in Duchenne muscular dystrophy: A Machine Learning and Explainable Artificial Intelligence study
items.summary: A machine learning study used actionable impairments to classify gait patterns in children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD), aiming to improve clinical decision-making by explaining how these impairments contribute to distinct gait patterns.
items.curatedReason: 对于DMD患儿，这项机器学习研究提示我们可以更早地识别出与特定步态模式相关的“可干预性缺陷”。虽然仍是观察性研究，但它可能为优化康复方案提供新的思路，指导你重点关注哪些步态特征。
items.titleZh: 通过杜氏肌营养不良症（DMD）的可干预缺陷预测步态模式：一项机器学习与可解释人工智能研究
items.summaryZh: 一项机器学习研究利用可干预缺陷对杜氏肌营养不良症（DMD）儿童的步态模式进行分类，旨在通过解释这些缺陷如何导致不同步态模式来改进临床决策。
items.curatedReasonEn: Predicting gait patterns in children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) using machine learning can aid clinical decision-making. This model helps you identify gait changes associated with actionable impairments earlier, optimizing rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性研究，可能存在数据收集偏倚，且模型结果的临床实用性和对患者结局的影响尚需前瞻性验证。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective study may be subject to data collection bias, and the clinical utility and impact of the model's predictions on patient outcomes require prospective validation.

items.title: A multimodal protocol for assessing real-world monitoring of lower-limb prosthesis use
items.summary: A multimodal protocol is described for assessing real-world lower-limb prosthesis use, integrating wearable and ambient sensing to capture functional performance, physiological effort, and lived experience beyond traditional outcome measures.
items.curatedReason: 该多模态协议的提出，意味着我们现在有工具能更全面地评估截肢者在真实世界中假肢的使用情况，而非仅限于实验室或自我报告。你应当开始思考如何将可穿戴和环境传感技术整合到日常评估中，以获得更真实的患者功能表现和生理负荷数据。
items.titleZh: 一种评估下肢假肢真实世界使用情况的多模态监测协议
items.summaryZh: 本协议描述了一种评估下肢假肢真实世界使用情况的多模态方法，整合了可穿戴和环境传感技术，以超越传统评估手段，捕捉功能表现、生理负荷和生活体验。
items.curatedReasonEn: The introduction of this multimodal protocol means we now have tools to more comprehensively assess real-world prosthesis use in amputees, beyond just lab settings or self-reports. You should start considering how to integrate wearable and ambient sensing technologies into your routine assessments to capture more authentic patient functional performance and physiological effort data.
items.limitation: 本研究为协议描述，尚未报告实际数据和结果，因此其在真实临床实践中的有效性和可行性尚待验证。
items.limitationEn: This study describes a protocol and has not yet reported actual data and results, so its effectiveness and feasibility in real clinical practice remain to be validated.

items.title: Comparison of high-intensity laser therapy and extracorporeal shock wave therapy for the treatment of plantar flexor spasticity in post-stroke patients.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 42 stroke patients compared high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) and radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy (rESWT) as adjunctive treatments for plantar flexor spasticity, with both groups showing greater improvements than rehabilitation alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了冲击波疗法和高强度激光疗法在卒中后足跖屈肌痉挛治疗中的比较证据。在临床实践中，可以根据患者具体情况和设备可及性，考虑将这两种疗法作为康复的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 比较高强度激光疗法与体外冲击波疗法在卒中后足跖屈肌痉挛治疗中的效果
items.summaryZh: 一项对 42 名卒中患者进行的随机对照试验比较了高强度激光疗法和体外冲击波疗法作为足跖屈肌痉挛的辅助治疗，结果显示两者均优于单独康复治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study offers comparative evidence for shockwave and high-intensity laser therapies in post-stroke plantar flexor spasticity. In clinical practice, consider these modalities as adjuncts based on patient needs and equipment availability.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 42 名患者，结果可能需要在大规模试验中进一步验证，且随访时间有限，无法评估长期效果。
items.limitationEn: With a sample size of 42 patients, results may require validation in larger trials, and limited follow-up prevents long-term effect evaluation.

items.title: Physical therapists as first-contact providers for musculoskeletal disorders: comparing beliefs across chiropractors, nurse practitioners, Physical therapists, and physician assistants.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey compared beliefs among chiropractors, nurse practitioners, physical therapists, and physician assistants regarding their capabilities, education, and scope of practice for first-contact care of musculoskeletal disorders.
items.curatedReason: 理解其他初级接触提供者（FCPs）对物理治疗师（PTs）在肌肉骨骼疾病（MSKDs）一线治疗中能力的看法，有助于识别并克服将 PTs 整合到 FCP 角色中的障碍。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师作为肌肉骨骼疾病初级接触提供者：比较脊椎按摩师、执业护士、物理治疗师和医师助理的信念
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面调查比较了脊椎按摩师、执业护士、物理治疗师和医师助理对各自在肌肉骨骼疾病初级接触护理中的能力、教育准备和执业范围的看法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding other first-contact providers' (FCPs) beliefs about physical therapists' (PTs) capabilities in MSKD first-contact care helps identify and overcome barriers to integrating PTs into FCP roles.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，仅反映了特定时间点的信念差异，无法评估因果关系或态度的长期变化。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey reflects beliefs at a specific point, thus cannot assess causality or long-term attitude changes.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Functional Electrical Stimulation and Stroke Rehabilitation Research: The Critical Role of Sham Control Groups.
items.summary: This perspective piece emphasizes the critical need for robust sham control groups in functional electrical stimulation (FES) research for stroke rehabilitation to ensure valid conclusions.
items.curatedReason: 本述评强调在功能性电刺激（FES）卒中康复研究中，严格的安慰剂对照组设计至关重要，以确保结果的有效性。在评估新的FES干预方案时，你需要审慎考察其对照组的设置，确保其能有效隔离非特异性效应。
items.titleZh: 功能性电刺激与卒中康复研究：安慰剂对照组的关键作用
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评强调，在卒中康复的功能性电刺激（FES）研究中，设计严格的安慰剂对照组对于确保研究结论的有效性至关重要。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights the critical role of rigorous sham control groups in functional electrical stimulation (FES) stroke rehabilitation research to ensure result validity. When evaluating new FES interventions, scrutinize the design of their control groups to ensure non-specific effects are effectively isolated.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: The use of eHealth in primary physiotherapy care: a mixed-method study.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study with 121 Danish primary care physiotherapists found common use of basic eHealth tools like email and telephone, while more advanced technologies were rarely adopted, identifying perceived barriers and facilitators.
items.curatedReason: 丹麦初级物理治疗师普遍使用电子邮件和电话等基础eHealth工具，但对更复杂的工具接受度不高。这提示，在推动eHealth工具应用时，我们应更关注用户体验和实际障碍，而非一味推广技术。
items.titleZh: 初级物理治疗中电子健康（eHealth）的使用：一项混合方法研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 121 名丹麦初级物理治疗师进行的混合方法研究发现，邮件和电话等基础电子健康工具被普遍使用，但更先进的技术应用较少，研究识别了其应用障碍和促进因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Danish primary care physiotherapists commonly use basic eHealth tools like email and telephone, yet advanced technologies see limited adoption. This suggests that future eHealth implementation strategies should focus on user experience and identified barriers, rather than just technology promotion.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限丹麦初级物理治疗师，且为混合方法，样本量相对较小，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study included only Danish primary care physiotherapists with a mixed-methods design and a relatively small sample size, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Associations of Walk-and-Turn Spatiotemporal Gait Parameters With Functional Mobility in Children With Cerebral Palsy at GMFCS Levels I and II
items.summary: This study found that spatiotemporal gait parameters during a 5-meter walk-and-turn task, along with lower extremity strength and range of motion, are associated with functional mobility and GMFCS levels in ambulatory children with cerebral palsy.
items.curatedReason: 步态参数、下肢肌力和活动度与脑瘫儿童的功能活动能力直接相关，评估时不可忽视这些指标。
items.titleZh: 脑瘫I、II级患儿步态时空参数与功能移动性的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，在5米步行-转弯任务中评估的步态时空参数，以及下肢肌力和活动度受限，与I、II级脑瘫患儿的功能移动性及粗大运动功能分级系统（GMFCS）水平相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Spatiotemporal gait parameters, lower extremity strength, and range of motion are directly associated with functional mobility in children with cerebral palsy; these metrics should not be overlooked during assessments.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未报告的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality and may have unreported confounding factors.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Protective Techniques and Postural Strategies for Individuals With Blindness or Low Vision: A Guide for Clinicians and Patients
items.summary: This guide outlines protective techniques and postural strategies for individuals with blindness or low vision, aiming to mitigate the higher risk of collisions, falls, and upper-body injuries they face.
items.curatedReason: 为视障人士提供专门的防护技术和姿势指导，能显著降低他们发生碰撞、跌倒及上身受伤的风险。
items.titleZh: 盲人或低视力患者的防护技术与姿势策略：临床医生与患者指南
items.summaryZh: 本指南为盲人或低视力患者提供了防护技术和姿势策略，以降低他们在日常活动中面临的碰撞、跌倒及头/上身受伤的高风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: Providing specialized protective techniques and postural guidance for individuals with blindness or low vision can significantly reduce their risk of collisions, falls, and upper-body injuries.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Screening sham mirror-therapy materials using fNIRS: protocol for an acute within-participant randomised crossover mechanistic study
items.summary: This protocol describes a randomized crossover fNIRS screening study designed to identify the most "neutral" sham mirror-therapy material condition by comparing its neural signature to true mirror visual feedback in healthy adults.
items.curatedReason: RCT 设计提示，通过 fNIRS 比较不同“假性”镜像疗法材料的神经信号，有助于在临床试验中选择更精确的安慰剂对照。
items.titleZh: 使用fNIRS筛选假性镜像疗法材料：一项急性自身对照随机交叉机制研究的方案
items.summaryZh: 本研究方案描述了一项急性、自身对照、随机交叉的fNIRS筛选研究，旨在通过比较健康成年人在真实镜像视觉反馈和三种预设假性材料条件下的神经信号，识别出“最中性”的假性镜像疗法材料。
items.curatedReasonEn: The RCT design suggests that comparing neural signals from different "sham" mirror therapy materials using fNIRS can aid in selecting more precise placebo controls in clinical trials.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步的机制探索协议，旨在筛选安慰剂材料，而非评估疗法疗效。
items.limitationEn: This study is a preliminary mechanistic exploration protocol, aiming to screen placebo materials rather than evaluate therapeutic efficacy.

items.title: Understanding how demographic characteristics impact the level of physical activity children with neuromotor impairments experience while using a robot-assisted walker
items.summary: This prospective study aims to examine how robot-assisted walkers' physical parameters and user characteristics moderate the exercise intensity achieved by individuals with pediatric-onset neuromotor disorders causing mobility impairments.
items.curatedReason: 理解人口学特征如何影响机器人辅助步行对儿童的运动强度，有助于你为患有神经运动障碍的儿童患者更精准地定制康复方案和优化机器人辅助设备的使用。
items.titleZh: 了解人口学特征如何影响神经运动障碍儿童使用机器人辅助步行器的体力活动水平
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性研究旨在探讨机器人辅助步行器的物理参数和用户特征如何调节患有儿童期神经运动障碍导致行动不便的个体所达到的运动强度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding how demographic characteristics impact the level of physical activity children experience with robot-assisted walkers can help you more precisely tailor rehabilitation programs and optimize the use of robotic assistive devices for pediatric patients with neuromotor impairments.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性单次干预，可能无法反映长期使用效果，且样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: This is a prospective, single-session intervention study, which may not reflect long-term effects and has a small sample size.

items.title: Early Emergence of Abnormal Muscle Synergies in the Human Upper Extremity Following Stroke
items.summary: This cross-sectional study investigated the early emergence and characteristics of abnormal muscle synergies in the upper extremity of 39 individuals with hemiparesis in the early subacute period (<6 months) after stroke.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后早期 (<6个月) 即可观察到异常的肩胛带肌协同模式，提示应尽早开始针对这些模式的干预。
items.titleZh: 卒中后人类上肢异常肌肉协同模式的早期出现
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究调查了39名卒中后早期亚急性期（<6个月）偏瘫患者上肢异常肌肉协同模式的早期出现及其特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: Abnormal upper extremity muscle synergies emerge early after stroke (<6 months), suggesting that interventions targeting these patterns should be initiated as soon as possible.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法确定异常协同模式与长期功能预后之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot determine the causal relationship between abnormal synergy patterns and long-term functional outcomes.

items.title: A grade-specific clinical prediction rule for independent walking after traumatic spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A clinical prediction rule was developed using the National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Centre dataset (2607 patients) to predict independent walking one year after traumatic spinal cord injury, with differentiated prognoses for individual ASIA Impairment Scale grades.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对创伤性脊髓损伤患者的临床预测规则，能基于 AIS 分级提供一年后独立步行的差异化预后。在早期评估和制定康复目标时，你可以利用这个工具，与患者及其家属进行更精确的沟通。
items.titleZh: 创伤性脊髓损伤后独立步行的分级临床预测规则
items.summaryZh: 一项基于国家脊髓损伤统计中心数据集（2607 名患者）的研究，开发了创伤性脊髓损伤后一年内独立步行的临床预测规则，为不同 ASIA 损伤分级患者提供差异化预后。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical prediction rule for traumatic spinal cord injury provides differentiated prognoses for independent walking one year post-injury, based on AIS grades. You can use this tool for more precise communication with patients and families during early assessment and goal setting.
items.limitation: 此预测规则是基于大型数据集构建的，但其在不同人群和临床环境中的外部验证仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: While built on a large dataset, the external validation of this prediction rule across diverse populations and clinical settings warrants further investigation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation
